name: block
description: Renders a Bulma notification banner section with title/subtitle, optional side image block, optional link ribbon, and a collapsible read-more area fed by inner markdown.

params.title: Banner title text (shown uppercase in side block, or centered when sub-block-side=cover)
params.subtitle: Banner subtitle text shown in the central block
params.class: Bulma color/modifier class for the block (default is-primary)
params.image: Page-bundle image resource name used as the side/cover block background (matched via .Page.Resources.GetMatch)
params.sub-block-side: Placement of the title sub-block: left, right, cover, bottom, or none (default none)
params.link: Optional URL for the link ribbon (local path or http/mailto)
params.animate: true to add scroll animation classes (default false)

name: block-section
description: Full-width fluid variant of the block banner: notification section with title/subtitle, optional side or cover image, optional background image, link ribbon, and collapsible inner markdown.

params.title: Banner title text
params.subtitle: Banner subtitle text shown in the central block
params.class: Bulma color/modifier class for the block (default is-primary)
params.image: Page-bundle image resource name for the side/cover block background
params.sub-block-side: Placement of the title sub-block: left, right, cover, bottom, or none (default none)
params.backgroundImage: Site-relative image path used as the whole-block background
params.link: Optional URL for the link ribbon
params.animate: true to add scroll animation classes (default false)

name: button
description: Renders a single Bulma button link with optional Font Awesome icon.

params.fullwidth: true to make the button full width (default false)

snippet: {{< button text="Download OSGeoLive" link="/download/" class="is-primary" icon="fas fa-download" >}}

name: button-bar
description: Renders a centered row of one or two large buttons; supports named button1/button2 params or legacy positional icon:text:link arguments.

params.button1-class: Bulma class of the first button (default is-osgeo-primary)
params.button2-class: Bulma class of the second button (default is-osgeo-secondary)
params.animate: true to add scroll animation classes (default false)
params.0: Legacy fallback: positional args in the form icon-class:label:link (used only when no named button params are given)

snippet: {{< button-bar button1-text="Join OSGeo" button1-link="/community/" button2-text="Donate" button2-link="/donate/" >}}

name: csv-table
description: Renders a roadmap-style HTML table from a CSV site resource (file param) or from inner CSV content, with :rm-xxx: cell class markers.

params.file: Path to a CSV file in site assets (resources.Get); when omitted, the inner content is unmarshalled instead

name: cta-box
description: Renders a call-to-action section with a title, optional subtitle, and up to two large white buttons.
snippet: {{< cta-box title="Ready to map the world?" subtitle="Join thousands of contributors building open geospatial software." button1-text="Get Started" button1-link="/community/" button2-text="Donate" button2-link="/donate/" >}}

name: feature
description: Renders a decorated feature row with a heading, lead text, large image, and three captioned text columns beneath.

params.order: Decoration variant number used in left-deco-N and deco-block-N CSS classes
params.title: Feature heading

snippet: {{< feature order="1" title="Open Standards" text="OSGeo projects implement open standards for interoperability." img="/img/osgeo/osgeo-logo.png" col-title-1="Interoperable" col-text-1="Works with OGC standards." col-title-2="Free" col-text-2="No licence fees, ever." col-title-3="Community" col-text-3="Built by volunteers worldwide." >}}

name: hero-banner
description: Renders a large hero section with a positional title and inner content as subtitle, followed by a box showing the latest news page title.

name: image
description: Renders a single full-width image inside a section/tile container.

params.image: Image URL or path to display
params.animate: true (default) to add scroll animation classes

name: image-bar
description: Renders a horizontal bar of small rounded images with centered captions, one per positional caption:image-url argument.

params.0: Positional args, each in the form caption:image-url (repeat for more tiles)
params.animate: true to add scroll animation classes (cannot be combined with positional args)

name: image-block-bar
description: Renders a dark bar of image tiles with a title and subtitle beneath each image, one per positional title:subtitle:image-url argument.

params.0: Positional args, each in the form title:subtitle:image-url (repeat for more tiles)
params.animate: true to add scroll animation classes (cannot be combined with positional args)

name: image-block-section-bar
description: Renders a dark section bar of image tiles with a colored title/subtitle panel beneath each image, one per positional title:subtitle:image-url:background-color argument.

params.0: Positional args, each in the form title:subtitle:image-url:bulma-background-color (repeat for more tiles)
params.animate: true to add scroll animation classes (cannot be combined with positional args)
params.backgroundColor: Declared with default #FFF but not used in the output

name: image-content-bar
description: Renders a plain bar of small images with centered captions, one per positional caption:image-url argument.

params.0: Positional args, each in the form caption:image-url (repeat for more tiles)
params.animate: true to add scroll animation classes (cannot be combined with positional args)

name: img-grid
description: Renders images in two tile rows (first two args on top, the rest below), one per positional label:image-url argument (only the URL part is used).

params.0: Positional args, each in the form label:image-url; at least 3 required (first row uses args 1-2, second row args 3+)
params.animate: true to add scroll animation classes (cannot be combined with positional args)

name: img-grid-1
description: Renders a styled two-row image grid (first two args in the top row, remaining args in the bottom row), one image per positional label:image-url argument.

params.0: Positional args, each in the form label:image-url (only the URL part is used)
params.animate: true to add scroll animation classes (cannot be combined with positional args)

name: info-bar
description: Renders a primary notification level bar of big statistic titles with small headings, one per positional title:heading argument.

params.0: Positional args, each in the form big-text:small-heading (repeat for more items)
params.animate: true to add scroll animation classes (cannot be combined with positional args)

name: info-card
description: Renders a two-column card with an image on the left and a heading plus text on the right, inside a primary notification section.

params.animate: true to add scroll animation classes (cannot be combined with positional args)

snippet: {{< info-card "/img/osgeo/osgeo-logo.png" "About OSGeo" "OSGeo supports the collaborative development of open source geospatial software." >}}

name: info-icons
description: Renders a primary notification level bar of stacked Font Awesome icons with headings, one per positional heading:icon-class argument.

params.0: Positional args, each in the form heading:fa-icon-class (repeat for more items)
params.animate: true to add scroll animation classes (cannot be combined with positional args)

name: progress-bar
description: Renders an indeterminate Bulma progress bar, optionally auto-hidden after a timeout.

params.autoHideAfter: Milliseconds after which the bar is hidden via an inline script

name: qrcode
description: Renders a QR-code canvas for a URL (drawn client-side by the site's QR JS) with a Download button linking to the same URL.

params.0: Target URL encoded in the QR code and used for the links (positional, default https://)

name: rich-list
description: Renders a rich list tile (optionally a link) with icon or image, title, and subtitle; substitutes |version| and |ltrversion| placeholders from data/conf in the URL.

params.image: Optional image URL shown in the tile
params.listLink: Optional target URL; supports |version| and |ltrversion| placeholders
params.listTitle: Main title text of the tile
params.linkAttr: Extra raw attribute string added to the anchor tag

snippet: {{< rich-list layoutClass="third" icon="fas fa-book" listTitle="Documentation" listSubtitle="Read the project docs" listLink="https://www.osgeo.org/" >}}

name: spoiler-start
description: Opens a collapsible spoiler block with a clickable label heading; close with spoiler-end wrapping the hidden content.

params.title: Spoiler label heading
params.id: Optional HTML id for the spoiler container

name: steps-bar
description: Renders a numbered horizontal steps indicator with an icon and text per step, one per positional icon:text:is-active argument.

params.0: Positional args, each in the form fa-icon-class:step-text:is-active (is-active true marks the active step)
params.animate: true to add scroll animation classes (cannot be combined with positional args)

snippet: {{< steps-bar "fas fa-download:Download the installer:true" "fas fa-cog:Run the setup wizard:false" "fas fa-map:Start mapping:false" >}}

name: table
description: Renders inner markdown containing a table as an accessible, scrollable data table with optional caption, custom class, and id.

params.title: Optional caption text; also enables schema.org Table markup
params.class: Extra CSS class(es) added to the table element
params.id: HTML id for the table (random digits when omitted)

name: tabs
description: Renders a Bulma tabs header with up to five tab labels and inline JS that toggles matching tab-content blocks; substitutes |version| and |ltrversion| placeholders from data/conf.

name: blogroll
description: Renders a numbered list of community blog posts from the headless /community-blogs page bundle filtered by showcase type.

params.showcase: Showcase type to match against each blog resource's showcase front-matter param

name: commercial-support
description: Renders a list of commercial support providers (logo, linked name, description) from a file under data/commercial_support.

params.dataFile: Key of the data file under data/commercial_support to render

name: contributing-orgs
description: Renders cards for contributing organizations from data/contributors, sorted by total commits, with thematic contribution badges and activity indicators.

name: contribution-stats
description: Renders a grid of statistic cards (organizations, individual contributors, commits, supporting contributors, Sol Katz recipients) computed from data/contributors.

params.0: Which stats to show: all, orgs, individuals, commits, supporting, or sol-katz (default all)
params.1: Optional link URL applied to the stat cards

name: donors
description: Renders a sorted list of donor names from data/donors as rich-list tiles.

name: download-table
description: Renders a static comparative pricing/download table (free, small business, teams, enterprise tiers) with donate/subscribe buttons linking into the download flow.

name: flickr-images
description: Renders a gallery of image tiles from the headless /flickr-images page bundle filtered by showcase type, with configurable column width.

params.showcase: Showcase type to match against each image resource's showcase param
params.quantity: Maximum number of images to show (default 100)
params.columns: Bulma column width number per tile, or 'gallery' for a mixed 4/6 layout (default 2)

name: flickr-images-old
description: Legacy variant that renders numbered notification cards of Flickr images from the headless /flickr-images page bundle filtered by showcase type.

params.showcase: Showcase type to match against each image resource's showcase param

name: fund
description: Renders funder logo tiles grouped by level (Flagship, Large, Medium, Small) from the /funders page bundle or page-local funders resources, filtered to active, changelog, or past funders.

params.type: active (current funders), changelog (page-bundle funders/*md resources), or anything else for past funders
params.relativeImgPath: If set, logo paths are used as-is instead of being prefixed with the funders/contributors image path

name: funders-simple
description: Renders the funders-simple partial, a simplified listing of funders from site data/pages.

name: individual-contributors
description: Renders ranked cards for individual GitHub contributors from data/contributors, with avatars, honorary-member badges, commit counts, and thematic badges.

name: linux-packages-explorer
description: Renders a JavaScript file-tree explorer for Linux package downloads of a given distribution from data/downloads/linux_packages.

params.distribution: Distribution key (dashes mapped to underscores) matching a file under data/downloads/linux_packages

name: param
description: Prints the value of a key from data/conf as plain text.

name: param-link
description: Prints the value of a key from data/conf rendered through markdownify (so markdown links become anchors).

params.0: Key in data/conf to render as markdown (positional)

name: payrexx-widget
description: Renders a Payrexx donation widget with one-time/monthly amount pickers built from data/payrexx_products, currency selector, and optional skip/hide buttons.

params.otherMethods: If set, shows a link to other donation methods
params.skipToDownload: If set, shows a button to skip donating and go to download
params.alreadyDonated: If set, shows a button to hide the donate prompt

name: s3-file-explorer
description: Renders a searchable, sortable JavaScript file-tree explorer over the S3 downloads tree from data/downloads/s3_downloads.

name: shortcodes
description: Renders a thumbnail grid linking to every page under the docs/shortcodes/ section of the site.

name: sol-katz-award
description: Renders Sol Katz Award recipient cards (name, year badge, citation, description, links, photo) from data/contributors, newest first.

name: stripe-widget
description: Renders a Stripe donation widget with one-time/monthly amount pickers built from data/stripe_products, currency selector, and optional skip/hide buttons.

params.otherMethods: If set, shows a link to other donation methods
params.skipToDownload: If set, shows a button to skip donating and go to download
params.alreadyDonated: If set, shows a button to hide the donate prompt

name: supporting-contributors
description: Renders supporting-contributor cards from data/contributors, split into Organizations and Individuals sections sorted by start date, with role badges.

name: usecase
description: Renders the usecase partial for the first case-study page found in the project section.

name: usecases
description: Renders featured case studies as a JS carousel plus a grid of active case studies and a link to the archive, from project-section case-study pages.

name: usecases-archive
description: Renders a grid of archived case-study pages from the project section, newest first.

name: visualchangelogs
description: Renders a linked list of visual-changelog pages in the project section sorted by release date, newest first.

name: block-grid
description: Renders a colored section with inner markdown split by ---- into up to three columns/blocks, with optional subtitle, background image, and bottom bar.

params.isSection: Wrap the content in a padded section element (default true)
params.classes: Extra CSS classes on the content div
params.sectionClasses: Extra CSS classes on the section element
params.subtitle: Small bold kicker text above the first column
params.subtitleColor: Bulma color name for the kicker text (default complementary7)
params.showBottomBar: Add a bottom-bar class to the content (default false)
params.backgroundImage: Site-relative image path used as the block background

snippet:
{{< block-grid subtitle="WHY OSGEO" backgroundColor="dark" textColor="white" >}}
## Open Software
Free geospatial tools for everyone.
----
## Open Community
A welcoming global network of contributors.
{{< /block-grid >}}

name: box-start
description: Opens a Bulma box container with optional corner ribbon and background image; close with box-end, which appends a footer bar unless disabled.

params.class: Custom classes for the box (prefixed with 'content'); overrides the default container styling
params.classes: Alternative spelling of class, used when class is not given
params.ribbon: Optional ribbon label text shown at the box corner
params.ribbon-class: Bulma classes for the ribbon (default is-info is-small)
params.backgroundImage: Site-relative image path used as the box background
params.no-footer: On box-end: any non-empty value suppresses the footer bar

name: column-start
description: Opens a flex Bulma column inside a columns container; close with column-end.

params.class: Extra CSS classes for the column
params.animate: true to add scroll animation classes (default false)

name: columns-start
description: Opens a centered multiline Bulma columns container; close with columns-end.

params.id: Optional HTML id for the container

name: content
description: Renders inner markdown inside a full-width Bulma column with content typography.

params.classes: Extra CSS classes for the column

name: content-panel-grid-start
description: Opens a responsive grid container for content panels with a configurable column count; close with content-panel-grid-end.

params.columns: Number of grid columns via the --grid-columns CSS variable (default 3)

name: content-panel-start
description: Opens a styled content panel with optional icon, title, subtitle, and variant styling; close with content-panel-end, which can add a footer button.

params.title: Panel title shown in the header
params.subtitle: Optional subtitle under the title
params.icon: Optional Font Awesome icon class shown in the header
params.variant: Space-separated style variants: featured, teal, cyan, amber, dark, compact
params.id: Optional HTML id for the panel
params.button-class: On content-panel-end: footer button class (default is-osgeo-primary)

name: content-start
description: Opens a content section with an Edit-on-GitHub button and optional page sidebar layout; close with content-end.

params.classes: CSS classes for the inner container (default content)
params.header: Read from params but not used in the output
params.animate: true to add scroll animation classes (default false)
params.sidebar: Read from params but the sidebar is driven by the page's sidebar front-matter param instead

name: platform-content-start
description: Opens a hidden tabpanel div tied to a platform key (shown by platform-detection JS); close with platform-content-end.

params.platform: Platform key stored in the data-platform attribute (e.g. windows, macos, linux)

name: rich-box
description: Renders a rich container div with optional icon and inner content as markdown or raw HTML.

params.layoutClass: Layout/width CSS class added to the rich container
params.id: Optional HTML id for the container
params.icon: Optional Font Awesome icon class shown at the top
params.mode: html to render inner content raw; otherwise inner content is markdownified

name: rich-box-start
description: Opens a rich container div with optional icon, for wrapping other shortcodes; close with rich-box-end.

params.layoutClass: Layout/width CSS class added to the rich container
params.id: Optional HTML id for the container
params.icon: Optional Font Awesome icon class shown at the top

name: rich-content
description: Renders inner markdown inside a themed cont div used within rich boxes.

params.themeClass: Theme CSS class added to the cont div

name: rich-content-start
description: Opens a themed cont div for wrapping other shortcodes inside rich boxes; close with rich-content-end.

params.themeClass: Theme CSS class added to the cont div

name: rich-right
description: Renders inner content unchanged inside a rich-right aligned div.

name: rich-right-start
description: Opens a rich-right aligned div for wrapping other shortcodes; close with rich-right-end.

name: tab-content-start
description: Opens a tab content panel div identified by content-tab-N, toggled by the tabs shortcode; close with tab-content-end.

params.tab: Tab number matching a tab defined in the tabs shortcode (builds id content-tab-N)
params.class: Optional CSS class for the panel div

name: footnote
description: Renders a bracketed numbered self-anchor link like [1] usable as a footnote marker.

params.0: Footnote number used for the anchor id and label (positional)

name: language-select
description: Renders a language dropdown built from the site's lang menu and JS that rewrites link-with-language URLs when the selection changes.

name: rich-edit-on-gh
description: Renders a rich-list tile linking to the current page's GitHub edit URL, inviting readers to submit a PR.

params.layoutClass: Layout/width CSS class added to the tile

name: script
description: Emits a deferred script tag for a JavaScript asset resolved from site assets via resources.Get.

params.src: Asset path of the JavaScript file (relative to assets/)

name: table-of-contents
description: Renders the current page's Hugo-generated table of contents.

name: yeartag
description: Prints the current year at build time.
